items.title: Russell reignites Verstappen feud as Antonelli feat branded ‘extreme’
items.summary:
Kimi Antonelli set the quickest lap in Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying following an “extreme” tow, although it is Max Verstappen who will start from pole in Sin City.

Verstappen qualified in second but inherits pole due to Antonelli having a five-place grid penalty, demoting the 2026 world champion from pole to sixth on the grid. George Russell joins the Dutchman on the front row, having reignited his feud with the Red Bull driver.
